notes.title: WHEEL WEEK HAS BEGUN!
notes.content: [p]WHEEL WEEK HAS BEGUN![/p][p]A new season has arrived in Zula, and of course, it comes with its own week! We are celebrating the arrival of the Wheel Season with Wheel Week! Lots of gifts and events are waiting for you as part of the event![/p][p][/p][p]Gift Code: Reward-packed gift codes are everywhere—don’t forget to follow our social media channels and check the event page during the week.[/p][p][/p][p]Login Events: Every day in Zula has its own special login event—don’t start your day without claiming them.[/p][p][/p][p]Timed Login Events: Anything can happen anytime in Zula! Don’t forget to check our social media channels frequently.[/p][p][/p][p]Gold Bonus Campaigns: Gold Bonus campaigns will continue without slowing down this week as well.[/p][p][/p][p]Gold Offers: Don’t forget to log into the game often to catch exclusive offers for Zula Gold.[/p][p][/p][p]All this and much more await you in the Wheel Season in Zula![/p]

notes.title: v1.79 Update is Live!
notes.content: [p]v1.79 Update is Live![/p][p]Wheel Season in Zula[/p][p]Over time, the war between Zula and Gladyo had become even fiercer. With the new recruits, the scale of the battle was taken to a whole new level.[/p][p]Now, it wasn’t just about old enmities; there was a much more dangerous target: the Wheel Skin. Who will win? Zula or Gladyo?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/4e67dc5fd74292adda4eb138a55efefc0d402884.png"][/img][/p][p]DYNAMIC BANNER IMPROVEMENT[/p][p]Now, all players can see your best moves during a match. Thanks to the Dynamic Banner, every player who meets the success criteria during the match will have their info displayed on the boards with their in-game nickname.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/bd3f54b928da8ea642af938ee8cf77b41c0f20ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]FINISHER ANIMATION[/p][p]At the end of a round, when you eliminate your last opponent, are you ready to show off to all enemies? The Finisher Animation is now in Zula![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/033ca81a81b6add0041c6866e8f9ef05f020ef12.jpg"][/img][/p][p]DAILY WHEEL OF FORTUNE[/p][p]In Zula, you can now spin the Wheel to win legendary rewards. You get one free spin every day, and after that, you can continue spinning using ZP collected in-game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/1f8a5bf45f67fe47833da7cea44e303246cac12b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]ELITE WHEEL SERIES AND GLOVES[/p][p]The new Elite Wheel Series and Gloves, giving the season its name, are now in Zula![/p][p]AK47 | RSS | MPT76 | AWP | KAR98 | AUGSNP[/p][p]M93R | KARAMBIT | DOUBLE BOMB[/p][p]Gloves designed specifically for the Elite Wheel series are available for all characters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/5e2ec64fa7917d25ca4e1222a46033ed2632d8a5.png"][/img][/p][p]STICKER HEROIC SERIES AND GLOVES[/p][p]The Sticker (Heroic) series is now available for the following weapons:[/p][p]AK-47 | M468 | MPT76 | AWP | KAR98[/p][p]AUGSNP | L115A3 | DEAGLE | RAZOR | TRP90[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/02ead369aeeaf9244000c05fa9396961e3a3a098.png"][/img][/p][p]SPRAYS[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/e30ad2612f7d49021122e8e8d8b653f2f5d9a8f5.png"][/img][/p][p]CLAN LOGOS[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/125b7b85802e8b7a877e81a9447cda2ffdd21727.png"][/img][/p][p]OTHER FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/p][p]Fixed the bug where weapon pose reset constantly when switching between attachment tabs in the Customize screen.[/p][p]Fixed the issue where scopes didn’t appear on sniper weapon panels in the Market.[/p][p]Fixed crashes in Battle Royale mode.[/p]

notes.title: Equinox Week Has Begun in Zula!
notes.content: [p]Equinox Week Has Begun in Zula![/p][p][/p][p]The long-awaited moment has arrived for Zula fans! We welcome the arrival of the Equinox together and crown this special period with exciting campaigns, unique opportunities, and grand rewards. The Equinox Opportunities Event brings a fresh breath to the game, offering both fun and rewarding experiences. This event is packed with unique opportunities for everyone![/p][p][/p][p]What Awaits You in the Equinox Opportunities?[/p][p][/p][p]Daily Login Rewards: Special rewards every day you log in during the event. Each login comes with surprises![/p][p][/p][p]XP and ZP Bonuses: Level up faster, earn more. Every minute you spend during Equinox gives you extra strength.[/p][p][/p][p]Daily Limited Offers: Keep an eye on the market! Exclusive daily deals only available during Equinox.[/p][p][/p][p]Crate Support & Material Packs: The perfect time to grab the most valuable content! Special packs await.[/p][p][/p][p]Bonus Gold Packages: Earn extra bonus gold with your purchases and multiply your advantage.[/p][p][/p][p]Discounted Gold Offers: More gold at much more affordable prices.[/p][p][/p][p]Twin Blood Heroic Case: Every day, 10 lucky players win 100,000 Zula Gold! Maybe today is your lucky day.[/p][p][/p][p]MVP & Gameplay Events: Show off your skills, rise to the top, and win big prizes.[/p][p][/p][p]Nostalgia Market: On Saturday, September 20, don’t miss legendary nostalgia packs and surprises in the in-game market.[/p][p][/p][p]Equinox Week is not just about rewards—it’s also about unforgettable moments with your friends. In the world of Zula, every day brings new opportunities and every match brings new excitement.[/p][p][/p][p]This is the most intense period of winning, strengthening, and fun. Show both your individual achievements and team spirit.[/p][p][/p][p]In short, Equinox Week is more than just an event—it’s a giant step toward becoming legendary in the Zula universe! Don’t miss this special time and secure your place on the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 For full event details and much more, don’t forget to follow our social media accounts![/p]

notes.title: 60% Bonus Gold Opportunity Has Begun!
notes.content: [p]60% Bonus Gold Opportunity Has Begun![/p][p]In this special equinox week, where day and night are balanced, the power dynamics in Zula are being reshaped![/p][p]With the campaign valid between September 19–20, up to 60% bonus gold awaits you on gold package purchases![/p][p]Embrace the power of balance![/p]

notes.title: The Autumn Festival Has Begun in Zula!
notes.content: [p]The Autumn Festival Has Begun in Zula![/p][p][/p][p]Exciting days have arrived for Zula fans! With the Autumn Festival, brand-new events and exclusive rewards are waiting for players. Throughout the festival, both individual and community missions will heat up the competition.[/p][p][/p][p]What’s in the Festival?[/p][p][/p][p]Weekly Special Missions: Complete exclusive missions available only this week and claim valuable rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Login Events: Surprises await everyone who logs into the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Limited-Time Rewards: Special content can be obtained only during the festival period.[/p][p][/p][p]Community Missions: The Zula community will unite to fight for massive rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]MVP Events: Top-performing players will be crowned with extra prizes.[/p][p][/p][p]Upgrade & Mode Events: Special bonuses for certain game modes and upgrades will make the festival even more thrilling.[/p][p][/p][p]Limited-Time Opportunities[/p][p][/p][p]During the festival, players who complete missions, defeat their rivals, and advance on the path to victory will have the chance to collect unique rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget! This special event is only available for a limited time. Join the autumn breeze in Zula and enjoy the festival to the fullest![/p]

notes.title: v1.77 Update is Live!
notes.content: [p]v1.77 Update is Live![/p][p][/p][p] [b]TWIN DOUBLE IMPACT! [/b]Double Impact[/p][p]An exciting clash awaits you in the Double Impact Season![/p][p]Saba and Liya Asmere were born in Turkey due to their family’s duties. When they were just 1 year old, they lost their parents in an attack on their family. Saba was adopted by a Turkish family, and the communication between the two siblings was severed. Liya, on the other hand, was raised by Gladyo and sent to Turkey to stop the rise of the Zula Team.[/p][p]Are you ready for the Double Impact Season?[/p][p]Complete tasks in the Double Impact Season, collect stars, and become the owner of the latest skins![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/d03ee1112e09a048cab295e45cf8e1483c5da163.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/5ace8cae0b89c6a5a936f399cc836c609b1ac807.png"][/img][/p][p]Twin Blood Season in Zula![/p][p][/p][p]2 NEW CHARACTERS (SABA ASMERE AND LIYA ASMERE)[/p][p]The new twin characters, Saba Asmere and Liya Asmere, are now in Zula![/p][p]An Exciting Showdown Awaits You in the Twin Blood Season![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/cfd355031ad5adaf2f4a5e76984b1d8f0a0a54ba.png"][/img][/p][p]Saba and Liya Asmere were born in Turkey due to their family’s missions. When they were just 1 year old, they lost their parents in an attack on their family. Saba was adopted by a Turkish family, and communication between the two siblings was severed. Liya, however, was raised by the Gladio and sent to Turkey to stop the rise of the Zula Team.[/p][p][/p][p]ZULA PASS PREVIEW[/p][p]Thanks to the new development, the later stages of Zula Pass can now be previewed before purchasing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/2db9c967111be44a9a0b4faeb533bd4196b75de3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Twin Blood season is live with its exclusive designs and content:[/p][p][/p][p]OBSIDIAN ELITE SERIES AND GLOVES[/p][p]The Obsidian (Elite) series is live for the following weapons:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/50bc9dee95875cd64e74f24751658d71de761b36.png"][/img][/p][p]AUG A3 MPT-76 RS-S1 AWP KAR98 MSR[/p][p][/p][p]The specially designed gloves for the Obsidian (Elite) series are now available for all characters.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]HEROIC TROPICAL SKIN AND GLOVES[/p][p]The Heroic (Tropical) skin is now available for the following weapons:[/p][p][/p][p]AK-47 GROZA RSS STORM MP109 CNK P90 MSR AUG KARAMBIT[/p][p][/p][p]The specially designed gloves for the Heroic (Tropical) skin are now available for all characters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/3cad4a36bcb9109763d9da2c00662eafa1c7edb6.png"][/img][/p][p]MULTI-SPRAY USAGE[/p][p]With the new development, players can now choose 4 sprays in the game. By holding the T key, they can open the spray wheel and select the spray they want. Then, by pressing the T key, they can use their selected spray at any time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/efe35a6404ce7931ed3581c8b0e44f7019773cc5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]CLAN LOGOS[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/0b8b04f09d5b50d780032e8d97d0ae6975a85ed0.png"][/img][/p][p]4 NEW SPRAYS[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/fb581d38e38f6782cc34335228b47af1bee4e850.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.content:
v1.75 Update is Live!

1. Eşref’s Hour SEASON

Eşref Alpan, under the watchful eye of Uncle Eşref since the orphanage days, had been working within the mafia on behalf of Zula. But everything fell apart when he discovered that his childhood love, Hayal, was actually a Gladio agent. He officially joined Zula. Will Eşref be able to take revenge on both his great love Hayal and Gladio?

Are You Ready for the Eşref’s Hour Season?
Complete missions in the Eşref’s Hour season, collect stars, and unlock the latest skins!

7.CHARACTERS: EŞREF ALPAN & HAYAL VESPERA

Eşref Alpan:
Abandoned as a baby and raised in an orphanage, Eşref was visited regularly by Uncle Eşref from the age of three. Guided by him, he entered the mafia at age 18. Brave, fearless, and calm, he always followed his namesake’s words. He was preparing to marry Hayal, whom he met at the orphanage, but discovered she was a Gladio agent sent to get close to him. After being exposed, he left the mafia and joined Team Zula.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/39c9d0c22b26306101891fb9648419393db67ed5.png[/img]
Hayal Vespera:
Raised as a Gladio agent from a young age, Hayal was assigned to infiltrate Eşref’s life from the orphanage. Cold-blooded, stubborn, and dangerous, she never questioned her mission—until she began to develop real feelings for Eşref. After her identity was exposed, Eşref left her, but Gladio took her back. Now she suppresses her emotions and carries out even more ruthless missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/5cbb86467e69d3661553fcee7f90028e3d82f966.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.74 Update is Live!
notes.content:
v1.74 Update is Live!
1. “Open Again” Button for Cases, Decks, and Material Packs
With this improvement, players can now open multiple cases, decks, and material packs in one go—without leaving the screen, depending on how many of each item they have in their inventory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/d270b1a9065d696db489445cc4572d37d494e82b.jpg[/img]
2. Quick Revive Item for BR Mode
In Battle Royale Mode, you no longer have to wait while reviving a teammate. Thanks to the Quick Revive item, you can instantly bring your teammate back on their feet.

3. Faster and Smoke-Free Air Supply with ZIHA
Now you can call in an air supply in just 20 seconds using ZIHA—without any smoke!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/2b8ee86bfb028104f2934b8cb81a8aa376af26c2.png[/img]
4. Win Streak Feature
In Ranked Mode, you can now see your number of consecutive wins without losing. Plus, a new system has been added that allows you to compensate for losses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/a6f1d1a0105a71e58137d055fa2517f60267d488.png[/img]

5. 4th and 5th Character Booster Slots Activated and Displayed
The 4th and 5th booster slots are now available—exclusively for XP and ZP boosters. Also, all booster slots are now visible on the customization page.

6. The Breeze Blade is in Zula!
Ready to defeat your opponents with the power of the wind? Inspired by a fan and featuring iconic animations, the Breeze Blade has arrived in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/14cf48517b48aeb0bebcd534aa8c9a422f9dc093.png[/img]

7. New Meta Weapon: ATAK
The new meta assault rifle, ATAK, is now available in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/a18d0fb3ded73c12318113e88d1b1b3071394d3c.png[/img]

8. Skins and Series for AUG A3S, ATAK, and Breeze Weapons
New skins and series are available for the AUG A3S, ATAK, and Breeze-themed weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/fc39f1d3fb752501588b060ddd333581a86c467c.png[/img]

9. Lucky Fish Series: Red, Blue, and Yellow Editions
The beloved Lucky Fish Series returns—now in vibrant Red, Blue, and Yellow colors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/41afc3353ab96cf26bd66193ced4f593f7c62317.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/51eb8108f276788264cd9a059a59b77fdd0714ba.png[/img]

The level-up and reward pop-up UI has been refreshed with updated visuals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/8726804abf68ef118accfc22a227ff13b0eb5b22.jpg[/img]

New customizable Clan Logos have been added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/ccc1767e83fa1f7d6260c8c9fc8700689660d55c.png[/img]
12. Sprays
New sprays are now available in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/f7e700fba8dd7a7ec14fca61a6040f65e432768b.png[/img]
13. BR Mode-Specific Movement Speed Boosters (+7% – +10%)
New +7% and +10% Movement Speed Boosters are now available for all characters in Battle Royale mode. Reach your targets faster than ever!

14. New Map, Weapon, Deck, and Case Badges
New badges have been added to the game to honor your achievements in maps, weapons, decks, and cases.

notes.title: OUR PLAYERS WILL BE PROMOTED TO FEATHER GENERAL ON OCTOBER 4TH!
notes.content:
OUR PLAYERS WILL BE PROMOTED TO FEATHER GENERAL ON OCTOBER 4TH!

Get ready! On October 4th, World Animal Protection Day, everyone who logs into Zula will be promoted to Feather General!

In 1931, during the World Animal Rights Federation meeting, October 4th was declared World Animal Protection Day in Florence to draw attention to animal species threatened with extinction. As Zula, we also wanted to support our animal friends on this special day.

We are launching a major operation with our players who not only excel in the game but also care for animals with attention and compassion.
On October 4th, World Animal Protection Day, we are promoting you and all our players to Feather General!
For every minute you play on October 4th, 1 gram of food will be donated to street animals. With your support and efforts, we aim to donate millions of grams of food and surprise you with special gifts in this grand project.

Remember! If you’re not there, we’re missing a Feather General and hundreds of grams of food.

notes.title: The adventure-filled Guardian season is now in Zula!
notes.content:
The Zula team was shaken by the news that the Last Guardian, Demir, was being held captive by Gladyo. Under the leadership of Uncle Eşref, a plan was quickly made, and they silently infiltrated Gladyo's headquarters at midnight. With Ali disabling the electronic systems, Zeynep neutralized the guards. Deep within the building, they found Demir and swiftly rescued him, retreating quickly. Facing his team, Demir said, ""Zula always wins,"" and the team rejoiced in being reunited.

The adventure-filled Guardian season is now in Zula!

Ramadan has arrived, and a special festival begins in the world of Zula for this holy month. We're here with a blockbuster campaign that Zula players will absolutely love.

A Golden Opportunity: Ramadan Special Bonus Gold Campaign

notes.title: Ramadan Blessings in Zula
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/0d1a563cd43a5f3649dde1aeef13f178a6b6b695.jpg[/img]

Ramadan Blessings in Zula

Turkey's first and only MMOFPS game, Zula, takes the gaming experience to the next level with the campaigns and events it offers to players specially for Ramadan. Within the scope of these events organized under the name ""Ramadan Blessings"", special deals, special events, an extra 11% increase in upgrade success rate, 11% discount on material requirements and much more are offered for Zula players. Are you ready for a month full of Ramadan Blessings?

Upgrade Success Increase: +11%
During Ramadan, players' chances of success are increased by an extra 11% when upgrading their weapons. Thanks to this increase, players will have a higher success rate in upgrades and will have the opportunity to maximize their performance in the game.

11% Discount on Material Requirements
Likewise, an 11% discount is applied to the materials required for upgrades. With this discount, the amount of materials players need to upgrade their equipment will decrease, allowing them to make more upgrades with less effort and resources.

More with Ramadan Abundance Activities
Within the scope of the Ramadan Blessings campaign, in addition to the increase in upgrade success and discounts on material requirements, Zula offers special missions, iftar and sahur time bonuses, special tournaments, discounted packages and maps specially designed for Ramadan, allowing players to spend this holy month in the most fruitful way.

You are invited to Zula for a Ramadan month full of in-game advantages and special events. Not only tough competitions and exciting missions await players; At the same time, gaming experiences are further enriched with these special advantages that reflect the spirit of Ramadan. Ramadan in Zula will be a symbol of both competition and abundance.

notes.title: Zula is 9 years old!
notes.content:
Zula is 9 years old!

Our first and only MMOFPS game developed in Turkey, Zula, is 9 years old. The day we first met with you is still fresh in our minds as if it were yesterday. We take pride in being a game produced in Turkey and currently played in 110 countries. Since the first day Zula was tested, we thank the 40 million players around the world who have experienced this excitement with us. Just like before, in our 9th year, with the excitement of the first day, we will continue to develop and renew Zula with the motto you asked, we did.
Here's to many more years together!

We celebrate our 9th year with beautiful events and gifts.

notes.title: v1.54 Update is Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/a8599dcc371c982b77a7fdc9fb695b2017db6082.jpg[/img]

NEW CHARACTER “OMAR RABI”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/cb2bc8d38e3195cb0dfce96abd783ca07e42a409.png[/img]

Omar Rabi was a treasure hunter born in the ancient Egyptian lands, pursuing the secrets hidden under the historical sands.
The history of the land he lived in began to attract him more and more every day. Despite his young age, Omar attracted attention with the knowledge and skills he acquired in treasure hunting. He was known not only for chasing legendary treasures, but also for his ability to solve these mysteries.

When Omar Rabi's story caught the attention of Larry, the leaders of the Gladio team, he was offered a special mission.
Gladio had a special weapon, imbued with ancient power and available only to legendary treasure hunters. Omar accepted this task and embarked on a difficult journey.

During the days spent in forgotten temples and ancient cemeteries in search of this weapon called ""Messenger"",
Omar Rabi was tested both physically and mentally. But overcoming every difficulty, he found the special weapon and managed to empower it with an ancient Egyptian spell.

The addition of this special weapon to the Gladio team showed that Omar was more than just a treasure hunter. His proficiency in close combat and the power of his special weapon made him one of Gladio's most valuable members.
When he joined the team, Omar Rabi became known as a new warrior, not only on the trail of legendary treasures, but also fighting against Zula.


As a new member of the Gladio team, Omar Rabi's background and knowledge gave the team a significant advantage in the fight against strategic enemies.
Omar Rabi, who always has a story full of mystery and excitement, brought a new breath to Gladio in his war with Zula.

ADDING TDM AND BR SEASONS

notes.title: Season 37 ''Infestation''
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/e428896d4bf3aa61d6ac33c8ba1242b1f005f32c.jpg[/img]

[b]Season 37 ''Infestation''[/b]

Zula was a formation that always tried to provide an environment of peace. Zula, who has patriotism and acts with the mission of protecting justice, was training himself in every field to fight a Global power called Gladio. Gladio wanted to invade the region by capturing the weapon codenamed "Artificial Intelligence" equipped with the latest technology.

Zula took action to protect the world from this danger by using his most elite soldiers. He formed a team to support him and started the movement against Gladio. His teammates were heroes with different abilities and powers, and each played an important role in the fight against Gladio.

To obtain Gladio's "Artificial Intelligence" weapon, Zula and her team participate in a series of challenging missions. They tried to infiltrate Gladio's military bases, secret laboratories, and strategic points. They had to overcome obstacles, disable their security systems and fight Gladio's soldiers.
In Zula, Demir Erez's leadership and courage inspired every member of his team. Together, they were fighting Gladio's powerful AI systems and powerful armies. Over time, Zula and her team uncover Gladio's plans and begin to weaken his control.

In a final fight, Zula and her team reached the center of Gladio. There, they confronted Larry, the leader of the Gladio. A great war broke out and Zula did her best to fight Gladio by using her abilities to the fullest.

Gladio wanted to fend off this attack and start the great war, codenamed Invasion, with the power of Artificial Intelligence. The only purpose of Demir Erez and his team was to prevent the invasion.

notes.content:

We are here with a giant update package that we prepared with full content in April!

1- Emote System
Matches are now more fun in Zula! With the newly developed fun emote system, players will now be able to dance or express themselves in the game. It will also play fun sound effects while using emoticons.
With this update, Clap, Apache dance, Backpack dance, Laughter, Uncrowned King pose, Robot dance, Worm dance and Surrender expressions have been added to the game.

The Toxic Smoke Bomb, which we are familiar with from the Battle Royale Mode, has been added to the game. Details about the Toxic Smoke Bomb are as follows;
Toxic Smoke Grenade inserts into the regular bomb slot.
It has an 8 second poisoning time.

[b]ZULA lovers in Europe meet at the "Zula Europe Masters" Tournament![/b]

The Deathmatch Tournament, which is full of excitement and has plenty of prizes, begins. The details of the tournament, where 1000€ prize havuzu be distributed, are as follows; 

How many people will the tournament be? 
Participation in the Deathmatch Tournament is limited to 300 players.

Which maps will be played in the tournament? How do I get to the top?
- First Round Favela 10 min 50 kills (top 3 go up)
- Second Round Favela 10 min 50 kills (top 3 go up)
- Third Round Favela 10 min 50 kills (top 3 go up)
- Fourth Round Favela 10 min 50 kills (top 3 go up)
- Final Round Safranbolu 100 kills

What are the prizes of the tournament?
1- 220€
2- 140€
3- 80€
4- 70€
5- 60€
6- 30€
7- 10.000 ZG 
8- 7000 ZG
9- 5000 ZG
10- 3000 ZG

In addition, 3 Khafre Pyramid Cases are given to each player who completes their matches! We have some conditions to participate in the tournament,

- You must have verified your e-mail.

notes.title: Version 1.42 Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/253e8aa2bbd343d60babfd8431671b99498aa293.jpg[/img]

[b]Version 1.42 Released![/b]

Zula continues to develop with your suggestions. We are here again with a full update this month.

Clan 2.0
We're here with the Clan 2.0 update to implement suggestions from our chats with Clan chiefs, social media, and our support system for a while.
Being a Clan member in Zula will now offer you different advantages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/a2b3a27fdf64cf14ed1125f9b83aaa977e1d5f1d.jpg[/img]

Clan Market
Added "Clan Items" category, which will be added to the market with Clan 2.0 in Zula.

Clan Levels (Level)
- Clan levels increased from level 50 to level 100.
- Surprise gifts can be yours depending on your clan's level!
- All clan gifts can get gifts when clan level up.
- When your clan levels up, you can see the gift you will get in the next level.

Clan Bonuses
With Clan 2.0, special bonuses for your Clan will be with you. Also, the bonuses you earn will be multiplied with your level ups!

XP BONUS
XP bonus is given in every match up to the clan players of the relevant level.

Zp BONUS
ZP bonus equal to the clan clan level in the relevant level is given in each match.

Material BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level are given an end-match material bonus equal to the clan level in each match.

BONUS BONUS
End-match elo gains are increased as much as the clan level for the clan players at the relevant level. It doesn't contribute to Elo losses.

Batlle Pass Star BONUS
The stars obtained from the quests, achievements and contracts are added as + to the clan players at the relevant level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/320962604839b7b407cc8ad2c137b55c9a4cc9ca.png[/img]

Upgrade BONUS
The probability of success in upgrading clan players at the relevant level is increased by the clan level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/4c0fe9ecec69fdc20b331b5e37fb4eb306314988.png[/img]

6. Bonus Card BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level receive a discount equal to the clan level when they buy the 6th card in the deck expansion. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/b30a89281c17febf8505736d9cf4a5fc1264a3b6.png[/img]

Jeton Market Renewal BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level receive a discount equal to the clan level in coin market renewals.

Card Refund BONUS
Clan level discounts are applied for card refund transactions to clan players at the relevant level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/b2650e59d90eb34d80c33c6a84d448c2d05eb5e7.png[/img]

Season Token BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level are given clan level season tokens in fast lobby tdm matches.

Competitive Token BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level are given clan level season tokens in fast lobby competition matches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/0a7663ad6a479a086fdc2a4c6c7e4af26f5d845d.png[/img]

BR Token BONUS
Clan players at the relevant level are given clan level season tokens in fast lobby battle royale matches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/69937453efb83407311f3250a2601ee90f38cf9e.png[/img]

Football Mode Now Available on Regular Servers!
You said you want to play Football Mode with our friends to the fullest, so we brought it to the regular servers special for Football Season! Let the shot you hit be the goal!

Groza Nerf
For players who call that Groza a nerf, Groza's deflection rate has been increased when the scope is closed and open. Groza lovers should not be upset, the Groza is still a very good assault rifle.

Football Season
As you know, we couldn't participate in the world cup this year. We wanted to bring this excitement to Zula. Football Season is now in Zula with its full content and only seasonal advantages!

Season Cases
When the new season comes, won't the Cashier come? Seasonal Cases are now in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/bfa944e07a5cf12777c60ef367b253877270d819.png[/img]

Orange Terminator
The Epic "Orange Terminator" exclusive to Football Season is now in Zula!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/7f57b1a309fe488d46f7e5003d57406edbc11fde.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/5772647763f32b4010ea42034c795a3dd409274f.png[/img]

Goal keeper's glove
Special Goalkeeper glove for the Football Season has taken its place in the new season!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/b3932c60361f38d3a07ec5c80cdf39a1281e0d38.png[/img]

Football Sprays
Fun Sprays special for Football Season are waiting for you now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/82e90bf3f66340995608a42abea77204edac2a0a.png[/img]

Zeynep and Elena animated keychain
Animated keychains of your favorite Zeynep and Elena characters are waiting for you only in "Sezon Market"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/bdf60b6291be1a56cfea186d4326f43e09b851c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/662201e0a122761d51e437b0261905903dfd7be6.png[/img]

Dragon Knife
The "Dragon" knife, prepared with Far Eastern lines, is only on sale in the Season Market!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/4e9b590fe027fa165adc94585ed1925d7d393ef7.png[/img]

Improvement, bug fix
- Fixed sensitivity adjustment problems that sometimes occur with mice
- Fixed a bug that appeared as - when discounts were applied on ZP products
- Added translation of Bora-12 Eleven Months card
- The graphic level bar in the settings menu has been improved.
- Updated Football Mode map to "Stadium".

[b]Zula 1.41 update is live![/b]


Zula continues to develop and grow! We are here with an update package like a bomb!

Are you ready to tremble with fear? The Horror House map that you have been waiting for in Zula for a long time has been added to the game with this update.

We're taking the tension and excitement to the next level in the House of Horror map. Are you ready to fight against mutants? Standing up against powerful Mutants will not be easy in Nightmare Mode, where a player starts out as a Mutant!

notes.title: Zula Europe Masters!
notes.content:
Zula Europe Masters is coming!


After a long time, we are with you again! The countdown has begun for the Zula Europe Masters.


The Zula Europe Masters kicks off October 2-3 as we have everyone competing for 2 Million Zula Gold across the EU region.


In the organization where a total of 16 teams from the European region will compete for the 2,000,000 Zula Gold award, competitive and entertaining matches will be waiting for us.

[url=https://forms.gle/gpk2oMLHa23begj66]Sign-ups.[/url]
 

Zula Europe Masters 2021


1. DESCRIPTON


1.1. The Zula Europe Masters is a series of tournaments organized by Lokum Games. This
rule list is the official rule list of the Zula Europe Masters. All teams and players applying to
the Zula Europe Masters declare that they have read and accepted this list of rules.
 

1.2. Validity Period
The Zula Europe Masters Rule List remains valid during the period dec the start and end of
the relevant tournament at the Zula Europe Masters. The elimination or disqualification of a
team or player from the tournament does not affect the binding of the Zula Europe Masters
Rule List.
 

2. RULES
 

2.1. Communication
The official communication channel of Zula Espor is e-mail. In order not to miss important
announcements about the Zula Europe Masters, the e-mail address specified during the
application should be up-to-date. Team officials espor@lokumgames.com he should
regularly check the emails that will come from his address.
 

2.2. Privacy
The content of correspondence and conversations that take place dec any platform between
tournament managers and participants is considered confidential. It is forbidden to share
these correspondence and conversations without the written permission of Lokum Games.
Criminal proceedings may be applied and civil proceedings may be initiated against
participants who publish relevant correspondence without permission.
 

2.3. Information Sharing
Participants participating in the Zula Europe Masters are obliged to share information with
Lokum Games, including, but not limited to, first name, last name, date of birth and contact
information, if requested by tournament managers.
 

3. PARTICIPANTS
 

3.1. Number of Team Players
Each team must have at least 5 players participating in the tournament. In addition to these
players, 1 reserve player can also be registered. During the registration period of the
tournament, each player can register with only one team. The same players cannot register
with more than one team.
 

3.2. Character Names of the Players
When applying for the Zula Europe Masters, make sure that all players ' character names
are spelled correctly. Tournament tickets are sent automatically by the system, and the team
is responsible for tournament tickets that cannot be sent to incorrectly typed character
names. It is forbidden to make any changes to the character names of the players after the
start of the tournament.
 

3.3. Player Accounts
Each player must continue until the end of the tournament with the player account he has
registered for the tournament. It is forbidden to use a different account during the tournament
through a character name change or to include a player who is not included in the
tournament roster in the team.
 

3.4.1. External Applications
It is strictly forbidden to use external applications that give users an advantage, such as
macros, wall tricks, changing textures, aim bots. It is forbidden to play with game graphics
and texture using video card drivers. It is forbidden to change game files, modify the game
using external graphics programs.
 

3.4.2. Game Errors
Any intentional use of any game deficit or error may result in a penalty. It is up to the referee
to decide whether the use of the specified error significantly affects the game, whether the
round will be awarded to the team, whether the match will end or be repeated in favor of the
opposing team. In larger cases, the penalty for using game errors may be disqualification.
 

3.4.3. The Use of Cheating
Upon detection of cheating by any player, the tournament management conducts technical
investigations into which matches or for which purposes the cheat is used. As a result of
research on how the trick is used, the tournament management team can be directly
disqualified from the league, only the player can be disqualified, or Lokum Game Publishing
and Marketing A.Sh. penalties may be imposed as appropriate.
 

3.4.4 MOSS (Anti-Cheat)
MOSS: Monitor System Status is mandatory for ALL players and can be found
under: https://nohope.eu. Players must use the program for the full duration of all
matches. If a Player cannot use MOSS he is not allowed to participate in a match
and can grant a loss even if the Team wins. For a missing or an incomplete MOSS
file the player/team will be punished. Player can be punished by Zula Gold or game
suspension. Team can be punished too by Zula Gold or default win.
 

3.5. Team Manager
Each team must have a team manager. In the absence of a team manager, the team captain
will be considered a team manager. The tournament management will inform you about such
issues as support, appeals, transfers, prizes only to the e-mail address and phone number
specified at the time of application.
 

4. TOURNAMENT PROCESS
 

4.1. Teams
The Zula Europe Masters takes place with the participation of a maximum of 16 teams, the
prize pool may change depending on the number of participants.
 

4.2. Matches
During the tournament, no power balance is observed when determining the fixtures,
matches and match schedule are determined randomly.
 

4.3. Tournament Format
All matches, including the finals at the Zula Europe Masters, will be played as BO3
according to the single-elimination procedure. In the matches played as BO3, the team that
wins two matches against its opponent will advance to the top round.
 

4.3.1. Match Rules
In the Zula Competition Tournament, matches are played in a Sabotage type with teams of 5
people. Matches will be played until the quarterfinals with the condition that the field wins 2
minutes 15 seconds/5 rounds, and after the quarterfinals with the condition that the field wins
2 minutes 15 seconds/10 rounds.
 

4.4. Match Schedule
October 2-3 All matches at the Zula Europe Masters are played between Dec. Lokum
Games reserves the right to make changes to match dates and times with prior notice.
 

4.5. Tournament Server
All matches at the Zula Europe Masters are played on the Tournament Server. If the Referee
/ Supervisor thinks that it would be inappropriate to play the match on the Tournament
Server, he / she may decide that the match should be played on a different server. In order
to avoid possible disruptions, all players should wait at the Tournament Server ready for half
an hour before match time.
 

4.6. Map Pool
Refugee Camp, Favela, Old Town, Wedding Hall, Chinese Gardens, Castle, Mardin.
 

4.7. Selection of Maps and Parties
There will be no map selection until the quarter-final stage of the Zula Europe Masters, and
all matches will be played on the maps of Safranbolu, Favela, Chinese Gardens,
respectively. In the announced match schedule, the team whose name is on the left will start
the match on the ZULA side, the team whose name is on the right will start the match on the
GLADIO side.
 

4.8.1. Quarterfinals, Semifinals and Final
Starting from the quarter-final stage (including the finals), the map selection will take place
as follows:
 

B Team 1. Map BAN
A Team 2. Map BAN
B Team 3. Map BAN
A Team 4. Map BAN
A Team 1. Map and Side PICK
B Team 2. Map and Side PICK
Team A is 3rd. Map and Side PICK
 

4.9. Start of The Tournament Match
All matches at the Zula Europe Masters begin at the specified match time. Teams that are
not ready as 5 people in the room at the specified match time are disqualified from the
tournament.
 

4.10. Technical Problems with the Player
After a match starts at the Zula Europe Masters, the match continues even if there are drops
from the game. If a team falls to 2 people during a match, the relevant team is considered to
have lost the match that is currently in progress.
 

4.11. Cast Changes
At the Zula Europe Masters, each team must continue that match with the squad that started
the match. Even if there are drops from the game after the match starts, the reserve player
cannot be included in the match, only players who have fallen out of the game can be
connected to the match again. A change of player is made only on the sidelines of dec
match. The reserve player of the changing team who enters the room during the match will
be kicked out of the room.
 

4.12. Registration of the Match Score
Team captains must take a screenshot at the end of the match that clearly and clearly shows
the result of the match. If requested by the tournament management, the team is obliged to
send this screenshot to Lokum Games. In cases where the match score cannot be
registered with the screenshot, both teams may be disqualified from the tournament.
 

5. BROADCAST
 

5.1. Publishing Rights
All publishing rights of Zula Europe Masters belong to Lokum Games. The players may not
refuse to have the matches published by the officials of Lokum Games and agree to
cooperate in the cases necessary for the publication of these matches.
 

5.2. Individual Publications
Players who have played at the Zula Europe Masters can open their personal publications.
The player himself and his team will be responsible for any problems that may arise due to
personal publications opened by players.
 

6. MISCONDUCT


Each player participating in the Zula Europe Masters agrees and undertakes to act in
accordance with the Zula Code of Conduct and the Zula User Agreement. Each player is
also obliged to respect all elements of the tournament, especially the tournament managers
and their opponents in the tournament.
 

7. AWARDS
 

7.1. Zula Gold Awards
2,000,000 Zula Gold will be distributed at the Zula Europe Masters. The distribution of the
prize pool is as follows:
1.Team: 1.000.000 ZG
2.Team: 500.000 ZG
3.Team: 250.000 ZG
4.Team: 250.000 ZG
 

7.1.1. Distribution of Awards
Cash prizes won at the Zula Europe Masters will be uploaded to the team official's bank
account; Zula Gold prizes will be uploaded to the players ' Zula accounts. Players are not
required to make any changes to their character names before their rewards are loaded.
Players who make changes to the character name will not be able to upload their rewards to
their accounts before the rewards are sent.
 

8. IMPLEMENTATION OF THE RULES
 

8.1. Certainty of Decisions
Lokum Games applies all the rules contained in this ruleset. All decisions made on matters
including but not limited to the interpretation of these rules, the planning of the tournament,
the imposition of penalties are entirely at the discretion of the tournament authorities, and
decisions made by the tournament authorities are final decisions. Decisions made by
tournament officials within the framework of the Zula Europe Masters cannot be appealed.
 

8.2. Penalties
A violation of the rules contained in this rule set results in a penalty for the team or player
who violates the rule. These penalties may include a warning, a fine, or a ban from the
tournament. No penalty shall be imposed once and may be applied more than once in
repeated cases.
 

8.3. Rule Changes
Lokum Games reserves the right to change and update the Zula Europe Masters Rule List at
any time. If any situation that is not specified in this list of rules occurs, the right to evaluate
and decide on the subject belongs to Lokum Games.

notes.title: Update Notes - 18 August
notes.content:
In this update, we have discussed our work on new reticle customization settings, increasing the bullet bounce rate in the sniper, and a fix for the lag / teleportation issue.

[list]
[*] [b]Crosshair customization;[/b]
[/list]
You can choose three different reticles, individually customizable, copy and save your Sight code so you don't lose it, or share your reticle with your friends.

[b]Classic Crosshair:[/b]
After choosing the classic reticle, you can customize it like behavior, midpoint, outline, color from the section below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/1729e8edc26917ff20817c18cd2e256ae0527269.png[/img]

[b]The modern Crosshair:[/b]
After choosing the modern reticle, you can customize the stability, response, color and spacing from the section below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/52de546af6cad9eae65ee7d48ae5dfa790710ec0.jpg[/img]

[b]Point Crosshair:[/b]
You can customize the response, color and width of the dot sight according to your playstyle and start using it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31261486/984b41e94968c1393b23cb618035158640505af9.jpg[/img]

[b]Crosshair code and sharing with your friends:[/b]
After customizing your crosshair, you can share the code in the "Crosshair Code" section below with your friends by clicking the "Copy" button.

[b]How can you use the code your friend sent you?[/b]
After copying the code, you can click the 'Paste' button to start using the reticle your friend has customized.


[list]
[*] [b]Increasing the ricochet rate in sniper guns;[/b]
[/list]
Before, it was easier to kill your enemy with a jumping sniper. We've increased the bounce rate of the weapon to make it a bit more difficult and to make the game even more balanced.

[list]
[*] [b]Lag / teleport fixed;[/b]
[/list]
As soon as your internet is gone during the match, the system will instantly detect that the player's internet is gone and will give a notification to the screen.
If there is no internet connection for 10 seconds during the matches, the player will be suspended from the match. If this happens in a Battle Royale match, the player's suspension from the match is set to 20 seconds.

With this improvement, we've done our best to block players who cheat teleports and offer a more enjoyable match for you.

Enjoy!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261486/1291328c3cd68d1fbc4baacfdecdf1f9d7287cf3.jpg[/img]

Notas del Parche 1.19
 ► La AK47 posee menos retroceso, bias y más movilidad.

 ► El Modo competitivo fue mejorado en el Balance, ahora los usuarios van a poder tener partidas mas balanceadas. (Esta funcionalidad se encuentra en Beta y será mejorada con el correr de los días de acuerdo al feedback que tengamos del nuevo Balance)
 ► Nuevas Cartas de Customización: Silenciadores Lobo Rojo y Halcón 
 ► Nuevas Cartas de Customización:  Silencers, Scopes, Sights, Muzzles y Lasers Espectro y Serpiente
 ► Nuevo Mazo: Mazo Platino de Asalto
 ► Nuevo Mazo: Mazo Platino SMG
 ► Nuevo Mazo: Mazo de Sniper
 ► Nuevo Modo de Juego: Boss Hunt
 ► Nuevas Opciones: Esconder las invitaciones del Clan
 ► Nuevas Opciones: Esconder las invitaciones de Amigos
 ► Nuevas Opciones: Esconder la Mejora Neon y Kaychain
 ► Nueva Arma: Tommy Gun

 ► Se actualizo Battleye
 ► Los jugadores pueden ser espectadores al hacer click en los números en 'espectador de torneos' (equipo izquierdo 1-2-3-4-5, equipo derecho 6-7-8-9-0)
 ► El inicio rápido ahora puede ser buscado por partidas con Pistolas, Escopetas, Sniper, Asalto, Cuchillo. 
 ► Los mensajes de radio puede ser usados más frecuentemente.
 ► Puedes obtener recompensas aleatoreas en las Partidas Competitivas.
 ► El botón de configuraciones ha sido removido.
 ► El rango promedio competitivo de los jugadores del clan ahora puede verse en el menú del clan.
 ► El nivel promedio de los jugadores del clan ahora se visualiza en el menú del clan. 
 ► El Chat ahora es más legible dentro de la partida.
 ► El nombre del clan ahora aparece escrito en la invitación al clan.
 ► El ícono del rango competitivo ahora puede verse en el perfil del usuario.
 ► El rango competitivo ahora se visualiza en el perfil del usuario.
 ► El Ranking Competitivo ahora puede verse en el lobby.
 ► Se añadió el conteo para la 'Espera de jugadores'.

 ► Se agregaron nuevas Cajas con Recompensas!
 ► Las cajas que necesitan llaves para ser abiertas se pueden obtener de partidas del modo Competitivo.
 ► El botón para Encontrar Partida ahora se visualiza como 'Listo' para los jugadores excepto para el capitán.
 ► Se solucionó el error del juego causado por las invitaciones mientras se abren los mazos.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el cual el comando /uihud 0 no esconde los íconos 'Plantar Bomba' y 'Desarmar Bomba' en el modo sabotage.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que el Skin Cheytac Camo se ve con la imagen del XM8 Camo.
 ► Se solucionó el error en donde se ve de forma incorrecta el siguiente rango en el perfil del usuario.
 ► Se solucionó el error 'Nexus too small' en los mapas de Sabotage.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que en 'inicio rápido' se bloquea una partida tras unirse.
 ► Se solucionó el error causado por seleccionar a Zeynep o Elena en el modo competitivo.
 ► Se solucionó la alineación del texto 'Info'
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que un jugador puede ingresar en el equipo enemigo en las partidas de clan.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que al estar AFK el juego se cerraba en el lobby de Competitivo
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que no se mostraba el clan en la lista luego de ser creado.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que el logo del clan, el nombre y los miembros no se actualizaban inmediatamente si se modificaba.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que la lista de los jugadores del clan no se veía correctamente. 
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que los rangos de Competitivo no se visualizan correctamente.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que un jugador muerto no recibe experiencia en el modo Escolta.
 ► Se solucionó el error de los radios Plantar Bomba / Desactivar Bomba que estaban al revés.
 ► Se solucionó el error del modo Escolta el cuál no contaba en el perfil.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que botón 'Extender' y el texto se sobreponían.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el cuál el modo 'Death Match' no se puede crear en 30 minutos.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que el juego se congela cuando el usuario quieren salir de la partida y luego presiona ESC.
 ► Se solucionó el error que deja las manos vacías luego de lanzar la C5.
 ► Se solucionó el error en donde se reciben invitaciones cuando en la configuración está apagada esa opción.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el cual un asesinato da más experiencia que el objetivo en el modo Escolta.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que los mensajes largos se superponen en la pantalla en el menú de opciones.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el cuál el mini - Perfil no se actualiza si se utiliza el Reinicio de Estadísticas. 
 ► Se solucionó el error en el cual muchas solicitudes de amistad de diferentes personas parecen del mismo jugador.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que la Ottoman Slap puede ser recogida del piso.
 ► Se solucionó el error que permite que los jugadores puedan enviar mensajes generales en el Modo Competitivo.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el cual los jugadores no pueden ver a todos sus amigos en el menú de invitaciones.
 ► Se solucionó el error en donde los jugadores pueden ver el chat en el minimapa.
 ► Se solucionó el error en donde al asignar los botones rápidos (1-2-3-4) se veía como objetos no configurados. 
 ► Se solucionó el error donde algunos jugadores se veían como ' Jugador 0'
 ► Se solucionó el error en donde el mensaje del espectador se veía para todos los jugadores.
 ► Se solucionó el error en donde el espectador veía el arma levantada con más balas.
 ► Se solucionó el error en donde al usar el mouse en las opciones mientras se juega, este funciona en el gameplay también.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el cual la imagen del modo Buscado aparece debajo del resultado de la partida.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el cual las estadísticas del arma se veían en otros items del inventario.
 ► Se solucionó el error en el que el sonido Zula Gana / Gladyo Gana se reproducía de forma incorrecta para el espectador.
 ► Los lásers ahora son más cortos y menos visibles en tercera persona.
►►►Explicación para el modo Boss Hunt ◄◄◄
Cada equipo tiene un Jefe y su objetivo es tener más puntos, los cuales pueden ser adquiridos al matar al jefe enemigo mientras se protege al aliado.  
Cada eliminación de jefe cuenta como 1 punto. Si el jefe mata al jefe enemigo esto cuenta como 2 puntos. El equipo con más puntos gana. 
El jefe enemigo es naranja/dorado y el jefe aliado es azul.
Ambos jefes poseen un ícono en su cabeza y este puede ser visto a través de las paredes.

Esperamos que disfruten de la actualización, recuerden
